title: Texas A&M WR KC Concepcion had knee scoped, is expected to be ready for rookie minicamp

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Texas A&M WR KC Concepcion had knee scoped, is expected to be ready for rookie minicamp
sources.description: Wide receiver KC Concepcion is projected by many to be a first-round pick in April and it doesn't sound like an update on his physical condition on Monday should change that outlook.
